title: Official releases follow a pattern that makes the story sound stronger than the files
adds: The 2026 election and COVID/biolab releases were built the same way: mixed older records are picked, declassified, bundled under a theme, then described more strongly in press releases, speeches and posts. That shared method is real, but it is not evidence the two subjects are connected.
